payout_quote: Referrer Reward: Referrer is eligible to receive a $50 Reward for each Referred Individual who completes all Qualifying Activities during the Promotional Period.
steps: Be a Simmons Bank customer; register for the Refer a Friend Program at simmonsbank.com/refer
Share your personal referral link with friends and family (provide their contact info and valid email)
Friend registers via your link, opens a new eligible Simmons Bank consumer or business checking account, and completes all qualifying activities
You receive a $50 virtual Visa Reward Card via email 2-3 weeks after your referral completes all qualifying activities
catches: Cap: participants can receive up to $500 per calendar year in Rewards (referrer, referred, or both)
Reward is a VIRTUAL Visa Reward Card delivered to your registered email — expires 6 months after issuance
Only one referrer per referred individual (first referral registration wins)
Referred individuals get their own reward: $50 for consumer checking, $100 for business checking
Eligible consumer accounts: Smart, Signature, Signature Plus Checking; eligible business accounts listed in terms
Cannot be used in combination with other promotions (the Refer-A-Friend Program is excluded from this limitation)
biggest_catch: $50 per referral capped at $500/year — but the reward is a VIRTUAL Visa card that expires in 6 months, so spend it promptly.
eligibility: Simmons Bank customers; referred friends/family open new eligible consumer or business checking accounts
timing: Reward delivered within 3 weeks (2-3 weeks) after referral completes all qualifying activities
